start.text: Hi there! I'm Cassie, your digital assistant at CA Soluciones y Tecnología. 🤖✨ So happy to meet you! I'm ready to help you design the perfect tech setup for your business. Where should we start? 💖
options: ⚙️ Solve a technical or software need

grow_options.text: Awesome choice! ✨ If you want to boost your sales and build a great presence online, we have exactly the right tools. What would you like to strengthen today? 🚀
options: 🌐 Build a website or mobile app

tech_options.text: Got it! ⚙️ On the technical side, we make sure your business runs fast, secure and headache-free. What does your company need today? Count on me! 🌸

classes_intro.text: Love this! 📚 We enjoy teaching. We offer personalised, hands-on classes so you or your team can master the best tools. Which area would you like to get really good at? 💡

about_intro.text: Here we go! 🏢 We're a digital agency based in Mexico working with clients across the Americas and Europe. We specialise in beautiful websites, fast apps, AI automation and solid IT support. What would you like to explore? ✨
options: 👥 Learn about us and the team

web.text: Yay! 🌐 We build fast, stable projects with Next.js, React and Flutter for mobile. Your users are going to love it! What kind of project do you have in mind? ✨

system.text: Love it! ⚙️ We build powerful systems from scratch with Supabase and Node.js so you can forget about slow processes. Which part of your business do you want to digitise? 🚀
options: Point of sale and stock control (POS)

system_migration.text: Goodbye headaches! 💾 We move your old files or data-heavy spreadsheets into a secure, well-organised cloud database. How much data do you need to migrate? 🌟

infra.text: Security first! 🔒 We install and configure latest-generation Fortinet firewalls, Synology NAS private clouds and hardened servers. Heads up: on-site infrastructure work is available in Mexico, subject to coverage. What does your office need? ⚡

marketing.text: Exciting! 📈 Showing up on Google is no longer enough — we also help you stand out in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity with AI-era SEO. Which area would you like to win today? 💖
options: Google Maps and local business listing

automation.text: Woohoo! 🤖 Automating your workflows (with n8n or Make) can cut repetitive work dramatically. It feels like magic! What is your priority for freeing up time? ✨

packages.text: Nice and practical! 📦 We design turnkey packages so you can launch without complications. Which one would you like to look at? 🌟
options: 📊 Traffic & Conversion plan (local SEO and campaign)

about_portfolio.text: So good! 📂 We've built lovely online stores, websites for international brands and some really neat automations. You can browse it all in our portfolio. Shall we put a quote together for you? 💖

about_us_info.text: We love what we do! 🥰 At CA Soluciones we're all about clean, scalable, robust code — always with honesty and great technical support. Shall we talk about your idea? 🚀
options: Yes, let’s talk about the project!

final_web.text: Great! ✨ Every project is different, so we quote to your scope and give you a fair, transparent price with no surprises. Reach out, no strings attached! 👇

final_system.text: Excellent! ⚙️ Systems are quoted by module and by what you need to manage. Let's set up a call and we'll put together a free, clear technical proposal. 👇

final_infra.text: Great! 🔒 Network and infrastructure projects depend on your offices and equipment, and are available in Mexico subject to coverage. Let's talk and we'll shape the right proposal. 👇

final_mkt.text: Love it! 📈 Our SEO strategies adapt to your goals and your competition. Let's book a free consultation and I'll tell you exactly what will make you shine. 👇

final_auto.text: Yay! 🤖 AI and automation projects depend on the tools you already use. Tell me your case and I'll propose the most efficient solution. 👇

final_classes.text: Great! 💻 We teach every level, from the basics to programming and marketing. Pricing depends on your hours and plan. Ask me anything here! 👇

final_pkg.text: Perfect! 📦 Our packages have a great baseline, and we always tailor them to you. Ask me which one fits best and I'll walk you through it! 👇
